description: Grandi Derivazioni Idroelettriche - Impianti is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by siatservices.provincia.tn.it. Mapping of power plants, taking and restitution works that constitute the network of the main structures of the Great Hydroelectric Derivations of the Autonomous Province of Trento. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Large Hydroelectric Derivations — Plants" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RNDT, risorse idriche, restituzioni, centrali idroelettriche, GDI, derivazioni idroelettriche impianti. The listing shows 2024-05-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
